title: Form Energy wordmark
description: A plain two-line wordmark: the name in medium Roboto over a smaller, widely tracked second word, in the current text colour.
notes: text only, no logo shape; sizes with the font-size of its parent via className
name: formenergy-wordmark

props.name: suffix
props.description: the smaller, tracked word under it

props.name: label
props.description: label for screen readers when it is a link

props.name: className
props.description: font size sets its scale, e.g. text-[1.5rem]
